archive_note: The official GM URLs and artifact metadata are verified. These ten artifacts were not present in the public brochure-source-archive-v1 release when checked on 2026-08-07. Each source therefore records a null archive_url and the deterministic planned_archive_url without claiming that the planned link is live.

unresolved.description: The retained Dealer Order Guide color selection page visibly prints REVISED: 1-2 at the right edge, but the remaining characters are clipped from the source scan. The audit does not infer the missing date characters.

The governing Limited Edition Corvette order sheet states that special two-tone paint with accent stripes is included, but it does not identify the stripe hue or paint code. The stripe program is retained as incomplete and must not be promoted as a named color.
